onePageSummary: ‘Energy — How Things Work’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects forms and sources of energy, everyday devices, energy transformations, fuel and electricity use, safety. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.

Define or explain fuel and electricity use.
Define or explain observation and evidence.
Define or explain cause and consequence.
examStrategy: Read the situation, identify the relevant idea, support the answer with evidence or working, and check before submitting.
